description: The MONROE-SOMETIME project publishes results from three 4G mobile-network experiments comparing available bandwidth with achieved throughput. The Zenodo page names log files, packet traces and processed analysis files produced by Yaz, Pathload and D-ITG tools; it lists one public 654 MB tar.gz archive under CC BY-SA 4.0. These paired active and packet-level measurements could help calibrate or test telecom-capacity simulations for mobile services. The resource is historical experimental evidence, not an operational 4G feed or a network simulator. The landing page does not state the exact countries, sampling dates, units or archive file schema, referring to a separate study for the experiment details. Its geographic scope is therefore a broad regional discovery classification, not a claimed map of coverage. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these three campaigns. The archive was not downloaded, so log structure and reproducibility of the throughput estimates remain unverified.
name: MONROE SOMETIME Dataset
